# KMK: the real Keiyoushi extensions the `extension-check` job of .github/workflows/build_desktop.yml loads into the
# packaged desktop app (docs/kmp-desktop/ATLAS_INSTRUCTIONS.md, ANSWER 010). One line per extension:
#
#   <package> <commit of keiyoushi/extensions' repo branch> <SHA-256 of the APK> <APK file name>
#
# The job reads that commit's index.pb for the APK's download URL, downloads it and compares its SHA-256 before
# anything is loaded; a different hash fails the job without running the file. No APK is committed.
# To bump: `.github/scripts/desktop_test_extensions.sh pin .github/desktop-test-extensions.txt` prints these lines for
# the current head of the repo branch; replace them in a reviewed commit.
